title: spermacoce quadrisulcata
intro: Spermacoce quadrisulcata, commonly known as the "Yellow Chigger Flower," is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family, native to tropical Africa. The health benefits of Spermacoce quadrisulcata include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments, such as skin infections and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as fever and rheumatism. The bioactive constituents of Spermacoce quadrisulcata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
